question: How many movies does the graph hold, counting TV movies?
paraphrases: How many films are in the IMDB graph?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN count(m) AS movies

question: How many TV series are in the graph?
cypher: MATCH (s:Series) RETURN count(s) AS series

question: How many people (actors, directors, writers and producers) are in the graph?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN count(p) AS people

question: Which genres are there, in alphabetical order?
paraphrases: List every genre in the graph.
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre) RETURN g.name AS genre ORDER BY genre

question: How many of the movies are feature films and how many are TV movies?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title_type AS kind, count(*) AS movies ORDER BY movies DESC

question: What are the earliest and the latest release years of the movies in the graph?
paraphrases: Which years do the movies cover?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN min(m.year) AS first_year, max(m.year) AS last_year

question: In which year was {title} released?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: $title}) RETURN m.year AS year

question: How long is {title}, in minutes?
paraphrases: What is the running time of {title}?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: $title}) RETURN m.runtime_minutes AS minutes

question: What is the IMDB rating of {title}, and how many votes does it have?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: $title})-[:HAS_RATING]->(r:Rating) RETURN r.average_rating AS rating, r.num_votes AS votes

question: In which year was {person} born?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: $person}) RETURN p.birth_year AS born

question: Which genres is {title} listed under?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: $title})-[:HAS_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN g.name AS genre

question: Who directed {title}?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie {title: $title}) RETURN p.name AS director

question: How many movies has {person} directed?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: $person})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS movies

question: How many movies were released in {year}?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.year = $year RETURN count(m) AS movies

question: Which movies with at least 100,000 votes are rated 9.0 or higher?
paraphrases: List the movies rated 9 or above that have 100k or more votes.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_RATING]->(r:Rating) WHERE r.num_votes >= 100000 AND r.average_rating >= 9.0 RETURN m.title AS title, m.year AS year, r.average_rating AS rating ORDER BY rating DESC, title

question: Which ten movies have received the most votes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_RATING]->(r:Rating) RETURN m.title AS title, m.year AS year, r.num_votes AS votes ORDER BY votes DESC, title LIMIT 10

question: How many movies are there in each genre?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN g.name AS genre, count(m) AS movies ORDER BY movies DESC, genre

question: What are the five longest movies by running time?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime_minutes IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title AS title, m.year AS year, m.runtime_minutes AS minutes ORDER BY minutes DESC, title LIMIT 5

question: Which movies has {person} acted in, from earliest to latest?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: $person})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS title, m.year AS year ORDER BY year, title

question: List the movies {person} directed, from highest to lowest rated.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: $person})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)-[:HAS_RATING]->(r:Rating) RETURN m.title AS title, m.year AS year, r.average_rating AS rating ORDER BY rating DESC, year, title

question: Who acted in {title}, and which characters did they play?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[a:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie {title: $title}) RETURN p.name AS actor, a.characters AS character

question: Who wrote {title}?
paraphrases: Who are the credited writers of {title}?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:WROTE]->(m:Movie {title: $title}) RETURN p.name AS writer

question: Which character did {person} play in {title}?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: $person})-[a:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie {title: $title}) RETURN a.characters AS character

question: What is the average rating of {genre} movies, to two decimal places?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: $genre}) MATCH (m)-[:HAS_RATING]->(r:Rating) RETURN count(m) AS movies, round(avg(r.average_rating) * 100) / 100.0 AS avg_rating

question: What are the five highest-rated {genre} movies with at least 50,000 votes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: $genre}) MATCH (m)-[:HAS_RATING]->(r:Rating) WHERE r.num_votes >= 50000 RETURN m.title AS title, m.year AS year, r.average_rating AS rating ORDER BY rating DESC, r.num_votes DESC, title LIMIT 5

question: How many movies were released in each decade?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN (m.year / 10) * 10 AS decade, count(*) AS movies ORDER BY decade

question: Which TV series with at least 50,000 votes are rated 9.2 or higher?
cypher: MATCH (s:Series)-[:HAS_RATING]->(r:Rating) WHERE r.num_votes >= 50000 AND r.average_rating >= 9.2 RETURN s.title AS series, s.year AS start_year, r.average_rating AS rating ORDER BY rating DESC, series

question: Which ten TV series ran for the most years between their first and last year?
cypher: MATCH (s:Series) WHERE s.end_year IS NOT NULL RETURN s.title AS series, s.year AS start_year, s.end_year AS end_year, s.end_year - s.year AS years ORDER BY years DESC, series, start_year LIMIT 10

question: Which ten people have directed the most movies?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN p.name AS director, count(DISTINCT m) AS movies ORDER BY movies DESC, director LIMIT 10

question: What is the average rating of the movies {person} directed, to two decimal places?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: $person})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)-[:HAS_RATING]->(r:Rating) RETURN count(m) AS movies, round(avg(r.average_rating) * 100) / 100.0 AS avg_rating

question: In how many different regions is {title} listed with a release title?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: $title})-[:HAS_ALTERNATE_TITLE]->(a:AlternateTitle) WHERE a.region IS NOT NULL RETURN count(DISTINCT a.region) AS regions

question: What is {title} called in the region with country code {region}?
paraphrases: Under which title was {title} released in region {region}?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: $title})-[:HAS_ALTERNATE_TITLE]->(a:AlternateTitle {region: $region}) RETURN DISTINCT a.title AS local_title

question: How many movies run longer than three hours?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime_minutes > 180 RETURN count(m) AS movies

question: Which TV series has {person} appeared in as a cast member?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: $person})-[:ACTED_IN]->(s:Series) RETURN s.title AS series, s.year AS start_year ORDER BY start_year, series

question: In which movies did {person} both direct and act?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: $person})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p) RETURN DISTINCT m.title AS title, m.year AS year ORDER BY year, title

question: What were the five highest-rated movies of {year} with at least 10,000 votes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_RATING]->(r:Rating) WHERE m.year = $year AND r.num_votes >= 10000 RETURN m.title AS title, r.average_rating AS rating ORDER BY rating DESC, r.num_votes DESC, title LIMIT 5

question: What is the average movie rating in each decade, to two decimal places?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_RATING]->(r:Rating) RETURN (m.year / 10) * 10 AS decade, round(avg(r.average_rating) * 100) / 100.0 AS avg_rating ORDER BY decade

question: Which five genres have the most TV series?
cypher: MATCH (s:Series)-[:HAS_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN g.name AS genre, count(s) AS series ORDER BY series DESC, genre LIMIT 5

question: Which five director and actor pairs have made the most movies together?
paraphrases: Which directors keep casting the same actor most often?
cypher: MATCH (d:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:Person) WHERE d <> a RETURN d.name AS director, a.name AS actor, count(DISTINCT m) AS movies ORDER BY movies DESC, director, actor LIMIT 5

question: Which three directors has {person} worked with most often as an actor?
cypher: MATCH (a:Person {name: $person})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(d:Person) WHERE d <> a RETURN d.name AS director, count(DISTINCT m) AS movies ORDER BY movies DESC, director LIMIT 3

question: Which actors have appeared in at least four movies directed by {person}?
cypher: MATCH (d:Person {name: $person})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:Person) WHERE a <> d WITH a, count(DISTINCT m) AS movies WHERE movies >= 4 RETURN a.name AS actor, movies ORDER BY movies DESC, actor

question: Which three actors has {person} shared the most movies with?
paraphrases: Who are {person}'s three most frequent co-stars?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: $person})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(c:Person) WHERE c <> p RETURN c.name AS costar, count(DISTINCT m) AS movies ORDER BY movies DESC, costar LIMIT 3

question: Which movies feature both {actor_a} and {actor_b} in the cast?
cypher: MATCH (a:Person {name: $actor_a})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(b:Person {name: $actor_b}) RETURN DISTINCT m.title AS title, m.year AS year ORDER BY year, title

question: Across the movies {person} directed, how many fall in each genre?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: $person})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)-[:HAS_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN g.name AS genre, count(DISTINCT m) AS movies ORDER BY movies DESC, genre

question: Which of {person}'s movies as an actor are rated 7.8 or higher, among those with at least 10,000 votes?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: $person})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)-[:HAS_RATING]->(r:Rating) WHERE r.num_votes >= 10000 AND r.average_rating >= 7.8 RETURN m.title AS title, m.year AS year, r.average_rating AS rating ORDER BY rating DESC, title

question: Which actors have appeared in movies directed by {director_a} and also in movies directed by {director_b}?
cypher: MATCH (:Person {name: $director_a})-[:DIRECTED]->(:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:Person) MATCH (a)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(:Person {name: $director_b}) RETURN DISTINCT a.name AS actor ORDER BY actor

question: Among directors with at least ten rated movies, which ten have the highest average rating?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)-[:HAS_RATING]->(r:Rating) WITH p, count(DISTINCT m) AS movies, avg(r.average_rating) AS avg_rating WHERE movies >= 10 RETURN p.name AS director, movies, round(avg_rating * 100) / 100.0 AS avg_rating ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, director LIMIT 10

question: For movies in the {genre} genre, how many were written by their own director?
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre {name: $genre})<-[:HAS_GENRE]-(m:Movie) OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m)<-[:WROTE]-(p) WITH m, count(p) AS self_written RETURN count(m) AS movies, sum(CASE WHEN self_written > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS written_by_director

question: Who wrote for {series}, and which of those writers also appeared in its cast?
cypher: MATCH (w:Person)-[:WROTE]->(s:Series {title: $series}) OPTIONAL MATCH (w)-[a:ACTED_IN]->(s) RETURN w.name AS writer, a IS NOT NULL AS also_acted

question: Apart from the director, which writers have written at least two movies directed by {person}?
cypher: MATCH (d:Person {name: $person})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:WROTE]-(w:Person) WHERE w <> d WITH w, count(DISTINCT m) AS movies WHERE movies >= 2 RETURN w.name AS writer, movies ORDER BY movies DESC, writer

question: How much money did {title} make at the box office?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: $title}) WHERE m.box_office IS NOT NULL RETURN m.box_office AS box_office

question: How many Academy Awards has {person} won?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: $person})-[:WON_AWARD]->(a:Award) RETURN a.name AS award, a.year AS year ORDER BY year

question: In which city was {person} born?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: $person}) WHERE p.birth_place IS NOT NULL RETURN p.birth_place AS birthplace

question: Which movies are rated PG-13 for age?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.certificate = 'PG-13' RETURN m.title AS title ORDER BY title
